neighbours.label: A count of what something can produce, hold or fit (produce more eggs, held as many as, more homes built, capacity); promotes capacity, number, yield. Other facts about the same subjects stay quiet
fire: Queen ants lay far more eggs than workers.
At its height, the fort held as many as 3,000 men.
The plan lets more flats be built on small plots.
The ship's capacity was six hundred passengers.
Each cow can yield far more milk on this feed.
A larger hall would seat more guests.
The factory can now produce 900 cars a day.
Its storage capacity doubled last year.
quiet: Queen ants live far longer than workers.
At its height, the fort stood above the plain.
The plan lets more people walk to school.
The ship's captain was a quiet man.
Each cow can rest far from the barn.
A larger hall would look nicer.
The factory can now open at nine a day.

short: how much it can produce or hold
